   172→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   173→            if dim_key:
   174→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   175→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   176→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   177→                        continue
   178→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   179→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   180→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   181→                        if drag > 0.01:
   182→                            print(colorize(
   183→                                f"  Dimension drag: {entry['name']} costs -{drag:.2f} pts on overall score",
   184→                                "cyan",
   185→                            ))
   186→                        break
   187→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   188→            log(f"  dimension drag estimate skipped: {exc}")
   189→
   190→
   191→def _render_item(
   192→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   193→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   194→) -> None:
   195→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   196→        _render_cluster_item(item)
   197→        return
   198→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage":
   199→        _render_workflow_stage(item)
   200→        return
   201→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_action":
   202→        _render_workflow_action(item)
   203→        return
   204→
   205→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   206→    print(colorize(f"  ({confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   207→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   208→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   209→
   210→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   211→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   212→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   213→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   214→
   215→    if item.get("kind", "finding") == "subjective_dimension":
   216→        _render_subjective_dimension(item, explain=explain)
   217→        return
   218→
   219→    detail = _render_finding_detail(item)
   220→    _render_score_impact(item, dim_scores, potentials)
   221→
   222→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   223→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   224→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   225→        similar_count = sum(
   226→            1
   227→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   228→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   229→        )
   230→        if similar_count > 1:
   231→            print(
   232→                colorize(
   233→                    f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar findings. "
   234→                    f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   235→                    "cyan",
   236→                )
   237→            )
   238→    if explain:
   239→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   240→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   241→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   242→        base = (
   243→            f"ranked by confidence={confidence}, "
   244→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   245→        )
   246→        if dim_scores and detector:
   247→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   248→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   249→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   250→                base += (
   251→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   252→                    f"({ds['issues']} open issues)"
   253→                )
   254→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   255→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   256→            if dim_key:
   257→                for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   258→                    if ds_name.lower().replace(" ", "_") == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   259→                        score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   260→                        score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}" if isinstance(score_val, (int, float)) else str(score_val)
   261→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   262→                        break
   263→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   264→        if policy:
   265→            base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   266→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))
   267→
   268→
   269→def render_terminal_items(
   270→    items: list[dict],
   271→    dim_scores: dict,
   272→    findings_scoped: dict,
   273→    *,
   274→    group: str,
   275→    explain: bool,
   276→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   277→    plan: dict | None = None,
   278→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   279→) -> None:
   280→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   281→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   282→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   283→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   284→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   285→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   286→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   287→
   288→    if group != "item":
   289→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   290→        return
   291→
   292→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   293→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   294→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   295→    )
   296→
   297→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   298→        if idx > 0:
   299→            print()
   300→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   301→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   302→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   303→            continue
   304→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   305→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   306→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   307→        elif len(items) > 1:
   308→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   309→        else:
   310→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   311→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   312→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   313→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   314→
   315→
   316→def render_uncommitted_reminder(plan: dict | None) -> None:
   317→    """Show a subtle reminder if there are uncommitted resolved findings."""
   318→    if plan is None:
   319→        return
   320→    try:
   321→        from desloppify.core.config import load_config
   322→
   323→        config = load_config()
   324→        if not config.get("commit_tracking_enabled", True):
   325→            return
   326→
   327→        uncommitted = plan.get("uncommitted_findings", [])
   328→        if not uncommitted:
   329→            return
   330→
   331→        count = len(uncommitted)
   332→        print(colorize(
   333→            f"\n  {count} resolved finding{'s' if count != 1 else ''} uncommitted"
   334→            " — `desloppify plan commit-log` to review",
   335→            "dim",
   336→        ))
   337→    except (ImportError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
   338→        pass
   339→
   340→
   341→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   342→    if len(items) != 1:
   343→        return
   344→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "finding")
   345→    if kind in ("cluster", "workflow_stage", "workflow_action"):
   346→        return  # These kinds have their own resolution hints
   347→    if kind != "finding":
   348→        return
   349→    item = items[0]
   350→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   351→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   352→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   353→        primary = item.get(
   354→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   355→        )
   356→        print(f"    {primary}")
   357→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   358→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   359→        return
   360→
   361→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   362→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   363→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   364→        print(f"    {primary}")
   365→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   366→    else:
   367→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))
   368→
   369→    print(
   370→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   371→    )
   372→    print(
   373→        f'    desloppify plan skip --permanent "{item["id"]}" --note "<why>" '
   374→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'
   375→    )
   376→
   377→
   378→def render_followup_nudges(
   379→    state: dict,
   380→    dim_scores: dict,
   381→    findings_scoped: dict,
   382→    *,
   383→    strict_score: float | None,
   384→    target_strict_score: float,
   385→    queue_total: int = 0,
   386→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   387→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   388→) -> None:
   389→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   390→        format_queue_block,
   391→    )
   392→
   393→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   394→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   395→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   396→        state,
   397→        subjective_entries,
   398→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   399→        max_quality_items=3,
   400→        max_integrity_items=5,
   401→    )
   402→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   403→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   404→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   405→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   406→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   407→        print()
   408→        for text, style in block:
   409→            print(colorize(text, style))
   410→        print(colorize(
   411→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   412→            "dim",
   413→        ))
   414→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   415→        print(
   416→            colorize(
   417→                f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   418→                "cyan",
   419→            )
   420→        )
   421→        print(
   422→            colorize(
   423→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   424→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   425→                "dim",
   426→            )
   427→        )
   428→    elif strict_score is not None:
   429→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   430→        if gap > 0:
   431→            print(
   432→                colorize(
   433→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   434→                    "cyan",
   435→                )
   436→            )
   437→        else:
   438→            print(
   439→                colorize(
   440→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   441→                    "green",
   442→                )
   443→            )
   444→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   445→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   446→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   447→        for text, style in block:
   448→            print(colorize(text, style))
   449→
   450→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   451→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   452→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   453→    _objective_remaining = max(
   454→        0,
   455→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   456→    )
   457→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   458→        try:
   459→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   460→            subjective_drag = sum(
   461→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   462→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   463→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   464→            )
   465→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   466→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   467→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   468→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   469→            )
   470→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   471→                print(colorize(
   472→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   473→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   474→                    "yellow",
   475→                ))
   476→                print(colorize(
   477→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   478→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   479→                    "to re-score.",
   480→                    "yellow",
   481→                ))
   482→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   483→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   484→
   485→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   486→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   487→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   488→
   489→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   490→    if queue_total > 10:
   491→        print(colorize(
   492→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   493→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   494→            "dim",
   495→        ))
   496→
   497→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   498→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   499→        findings_scoped
   500→    )
   501→    parts: list[str] = []
   502→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   503→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   504→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   505→    open_review = [
   506→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   507→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   508→    ]
   509→    if low_dims:
   510→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   511→    if stale_count:
   512→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   513→    if unassessed_count:
   514→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   515→    if len(open_review):
   516→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   517→    if coverage_open > 0:
   518→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   519→
   520→    if parts:
   521→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   522→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   523→
   524→
   525→__all__ = [
   526→    "is_auto_fix_command",
   527→    "render_followup_nudges",
   528→    "render_gate_banner",
   529→    "render_queue_header",

   535→    "subjective_coverage_breakdown",
   536→]

   152→        command = (item.get("primary_command", "") or "").replace("|", "\\|")

   169→        print(colorize_fn(f"Wrote {item_count} items to {output_file}", "green"))
   170→    except OSError as exc:
   171→        payload["output_error"] = str(exc)
   172→        print_write_error(output_file, exc, label="next output")
   173→        return False

   185→        "md": lambda: print(render_markdown(items)),

   187→    renderer = renderers.get(output_format)
   188→    if renderer is None:

   191→    return True

1→"""Helper utilities for work queue item construction."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import re
     6→from fnmatch import fnmatch
     7→
     8→from desloppify.core.enums import finding_status_tokens
     9→from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
    10→from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    11→    all_subjective_entries,
    12→)
    13→from desloppify.intelligence.integrity import (
    14→    is_holistic_subjective_finding,
    15→    unassessed_subjective_dimensions,
    16→)
    17→from desloppify.scoring import DISPLAY_NAMES
    18→
    19→ALL_STATUSES = set(finding_status_tokens(include_all=True))
    20→ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "refactor": 1, "manual_fix": 2, "reorganize": 3}
    21→ATTEST_EXAMPLE = (
    22→    "I have actually [DESCRIBE THE CONCRETE CHANGE YOU MADE] "
    23→    "and I am not gaming the score by resolving without fixing."
    24→)
    25→
    26→
    27→def detail_dict(item: dict) -> dict:
    28→    """Return finding detail as a dict; tolerate legacy/non-dict payloads."""
    29→    detail = item.get("detail")
    30→    return detail if isinstance(detail, dict) else {}
    31→
    32→
    33→def status_matches(item_status: str, status_filter: str) -> bool:
    34→    return status_filter == "all" or item_status == status_filter
    35→
    36→
    37→def is_subjective_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    38→    detector = item.get("detector")
    39→    if detector in {"subjective_assessment"}:
    40→        return True
    41→    if detector == "holistic_review":
    42→        return True
    43→    return False
    44→
    45→
    46→def is_review_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    47→    return item.get("detector") == "review"
    48→
    49→
    50→def is_subjective_queue_item(item: dict) -> bool:
    51→    """True for subjective work items, including collapsed subjective clusters."""
    52→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    53→        return True
    54→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    55→        members = item.get("members", [])
    56→        return bool(members) and all(
    57→            m.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" for m in members
    58→        )
    59→    return False
    60→
    61→
    62→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    63→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    64→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    65→    weight_by_confidence = {
    66→        "high": 1.0,
    67→        "medium": 0.7,
    68→        "low": 0.3,
    69→    }
    70→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    71→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    72→        weight *= 10.0
    73→    return float(weight)
    74→
    75→
    76→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    77→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    78→    if not scope:
    79→        return True
    80→
    81→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    82→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    83→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    84→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    85→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    86→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    87→
    88→    if "*" in scope:
    89→        return any(
    90→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    91→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    92→        )
    93→
    94→    if "::" in scope:
    95→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    96→
    97→    lowered = scope.lower()
    98→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
    99→        return (
   100→            lowered in item_id.lower()
   101→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
   102→            or lowered in summary.lower()
   103→        )
   104→
   105→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
   106→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
   107→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
   108→
   109→    return (
   110→        detector == scope
   111→        or filepath == scope
   112→        or filepath.startswith(scope.rstrip("/") + "/")
   113→    )
   114→
   115→
   116→def slugify(text: str) -> str:
   117→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text.lower()).strip("_")
   118→
   119→
   120→def _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(display_name: str) -> str:
   121→    """Map a display label (e.g. 'Mid elegance') to its canonical dimension key."""
   122→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   123→    target = cleaned.lower()
   124→
   125→    for dim_key, label in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   126→        if str(label).lower() == target:
   127→            return str(dim_key)
   128→    return slugify(cleaned)
   129→
   130→
   131→def _subjective_dimension_aliases(display_name: str) -> set[str]:
   132→    """Return normalized aliases used to match display labels with finding dimension keys."""
   133→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   134→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   135→    return {
   136→        cleaned.lower(),
   137→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   138→        slugify(cleaned),
   139→        canonical.lower(),
   140→        slugify(canonical),
   141→    }
   142→
   143→
   144→def supported_fixers_for_item(state: dict, item: dict) -> set[str] | None:
   145→    """Return supported fixers for an item's language when known."""
   146→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()
   147→    if not lang:
   148→        return None
   149→
   150→    caps = state.get("lang_capabilities", {})
   151→    if not isinstance(caps, dict):
   152→        return None
   153→
   154→    lang_caps = caps.get(lang, {})
   155→    if not isinstance(lang_caps, dict):
   156→        return None
   157→
   158→    fixers = lang_caps.get("fixers")
   159→    if not isinstance(fixers, list):
   160→        return None
   161→    return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}
   162→
   163→
   164→def primary_command_for_finding(
   165→    item: dict, *, supported_fixers: set[str] | None = None
   166→) -> str:
   167→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   168→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   169→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   170→        available_fixers = [
   171→            fixer
   172→            for fixer in meta.fixers
   173→            if supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers
   174→        ]
   175→        if available_fixers:
   176→            return f"desloppify fix {available_fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   177→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   178→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   179→            return "desloppify review --prepare"
   180→        return "desloppify show subjective"
   181→    return f'desloppify plan done "{item.get("id", "")}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   182→
   183→
   184→def build_triage_stage_items(plan: dict, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   185→    """Build synthetic work items for each ``triage::*`` stage ID in the queue.
   186→
   187→    Returns an empty list when no triage stages are pending.
   188→    """
   189→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.triage_playbook import (
   190→        TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
   191→        TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS,
   192→    )
   193→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   194→        TRIAGE_IDS,
   195→        TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS,
   196→    )
   197→
   198→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   199→    order_set = set(order)
   200→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   201→    if not present:
   202→        return []
   203→
   204→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   205→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   206→
   207→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   208→    open_review_count = sum(
   209→        1 for f in findings.values()
   210→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   211→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   212→    )
   213→
   214→    label_map = dict(TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS)
   215→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   216→
   217→    items: list[dict] = []
   218→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   219→        if sid not in present:
   220→            continue
   221→        if name in confirmed:
   222→            continue
   223→
   224→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue
   225→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   226→        blocked_by = sorted(
   227→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   228→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   229→        )
   230→
   231→        cmd = f"desloppify plan triage --stage {name}"
   232→        if name == "commit":
   233→            cmd = 'desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "..."'
   234→
   235→        items.append({
   236→            "id": sid,
   237→            "tier": 1,
   238→            "confidence": "high",
   239→            "detector": "triage",
   240→            "file": ".",
   241→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   242→            "stage_name": name,
   243→            "stage_index": idx,
   244→            "summary": f"Triage: {label_map.get(name, name)}",
   245→            "detail": {
   246→                "total_review_findings": open_review_count,
   247→                "stage": name,
   248→                "stage_label": label_map.get(name, name),
   249→            },
   250→            "primary_command": cmd,
   251→            "blocked_by": blocked_by,
   252→            "is_blocked": bool(blocked_by),
   253→        })
   254→    return items

   257→def build_create_plan_item(plan: dict) -> dict | None:
   258→    """Build a synthetic work item for ``workflow::create-plan`` if it's in the queue.
   259→
   260→    Returns ``None`` when the item is not pending.
   261→    """
   262→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID
   263→
   264→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
   265→        return None
   266→
   267→    return {
   268→        "id": WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID,
   269→        "tier": 1,
   270→        "confidence": "high",
   271→        "detector": "workflow",
   272→        "file": ".",

   282→def subjective_strict_scores(state: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
   283→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   284→    if not dim_scores:
   285→        return {}
   286→
   287→    entries = all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   288→    scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   289→    for entry in entries:
   290→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   291→        if not name:
   292→            continue
   293→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   294→        [REDACTED](name)
   295→        aliases = _subjective_dimension_aliases(name)
   296→        for cli_key in entry.get("cli_keys", []):
   297→            key = str(cli_key).strip().lower()
   298→            if not key:
   299→                continue
   300→            aliases.add(key)
   301→            aliases.add(slugify(key))
   302→        aliases.add(dim_key.lower())
   303→        aliases.add(slugify(dim_key))
   304→        for alias in aliases:
   305→            scores[alias] = strict_val
   306→    return scores
   307→
   308→
   309→def build_subjective_items(
   310→    state: dict, findings: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   311→) -> list[dict]:
   312→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   313→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   314→    if not dim_scores:
   315→        return []
   316→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   317→
   318→    subjective_entries = all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   319→    if not subjective_entries:
   320→        return []
   321→    unassessed_dims = {
   322→        str(name).strip()
   323→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   324→            dim_scores
   325→        )
   326→    }
   327→
   328→    # Review findings are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   329→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   330→    for finding in findings.values():
   331→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   332→            continue
   333→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   334→        if not dim_key:
   335→            continue
   336→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   337→
   338→    items: list[dict] = []
   339→    def _prepare_command(
   340→        cli_keys: list[str],
   341→        *,
   342→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   343→    ) -> str:
   344→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   345→        if cli_keys:
   346→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   347→        if force_review_rerun:
   348→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   349→        return command
   350→
   351→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   352→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   353→        if not name:
   354→            continue
   355→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   356→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   357→            continue
   358→
   359→        [REDACTED](name)
   360→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   361→        cli_keys = [
   362→            str(key).strip().lower()
   363→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   364→            if str(key).strip()
   365→        ]
   366→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   367→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   368→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   369→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   370→            name in unassessed_dims
   371→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   372→        )
   373→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   374→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   375→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   376→        if open_review > 0:
   377→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   378→        else:
   379→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   380→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   381→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   382→        items.append(
   383→            {
   384→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   385→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   386→                "file": ".",
   387→                "confidence": "medium",
   388→                "summary": summary,
   389→                "detail": {
   390→                    "dimension_name": name,
   391→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   392→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   393→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   394→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   395→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   396→                },
   397→                "status": "open",
   398→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   399→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   400→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   401→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   402→            }
   403→        )
   404→    return items

    19→def dimension_cli_key(dimension_name: str) -> str:
    20→    """Map a display name to a review --dimensions CLI key."""
    21→    cleaned = dimension_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
    22→    lowered = cleaned.lower()
    23→    if lowered in _COMPONENT_TO_DIMENSION:
    24→        return _COMPONENT_TO_DIMENSION[lowered]
    25→    for key, display in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
    26→        if display.lower() == lowered:
    27→            return key
    28→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", lowered).strip("_")
    29→

    31→def scorecard_dimension_cli_keys(name: str, data: dict) -> list[str]:
    32→    """Map scorecard subjective display names to review --dimensions keys."""

    37→            .get("components", [])

    39→        if isinstance(components, list) and components:
    40→            keys = [dimension_cli_key(component) for component in components]

    57→    else:

    26→def write_show_output_file(output_file: str, payload: dict, surfaced_count: int) -> bool:
    27→    """Write serialized show payload to file."""
    28→    try:
    29→        safe_write_text(output_file, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
    30→        print(colorize(f"Wrote {surfaced_count} findings to {output_file}", "green"))
    31→    except OSError as exc:
    32→        payload["output_error"] = str(exc)
    33→        print_write_error(output_file, exc, label="show output")
    34→        return False
    35→    return True
    36→
    37→
    38→def group_matches_by_file(matches: list[dict]) -> list[tuple[str, list]]:
    39→    """Group findings by file and sort by descending count."""
    40→    by_file: dict[str, list] = defaultdict(list)
    41→    for finding in matches:
    42→        by_file[finding["file"]].append(finding)
    43→    return sorted(by_file.items(), key=lambda item: -len(item[1]))
    44→
    45→
    46→def _print_single_finding(finding: dict, *, show_code: bool) -> None:
    47→    """Render a single finding to terminal."""
    48→    normalized_status = canonical_finding_status(finding.get("status"))
    49→    status_icon = {
    50→        "open": "○",
    51→        "fixed": "✓",
    52→        "wontfix": "—",
    53→        "false_positive": "✗",
    54→        "auto_resolved": "◌",
    55→    }.get(normalized_status, "?")
    56→    zone = finding.get("zone", "production")
    57→    zone_tag = colorize(f" [{zone}]", "dim") if zone != "production" else ""
    58→    print(
    59→        f"    {status_icon} T{finding['tier']} [{finding['confidence']}] {finding['summary']}{zone_tag}"
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    detail_parts = format_detail(finding.get("detail", {}))
    63→    if detail_parts:
    64→        print(colorize(f"      {' · '.join(detail_parts)}", "dim"))
    65→    if show_code:
    66→        detail = finding.get("detail", {})
    67→        target_line = (
    68→            detail.get("line") or (detail.get("lines", [None]) or [None])[0]
    69→        )
    70→        if target_line and finding["file"] not in (".", ""):
    71→            snippet = read_code_snippet(finding["file"], target_line)
    72→            if snippet:
    73→                print(snippet)
    74→    if finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2:
    75→        print(
    76→            colorize(
    77→                f"      ⟳ reopened {finding['reopen_count']} times — fix properly or wontfix",
    78→                "red",
    79→            )
    80→        )
    81→    if finding.get("note"):
    82→        print(colorize(f"      note: {finding['note']}", "dim"))
    83→    print(colorize(f"      {finding['id']}", "dim"))

    86→def render_findings(
    87→    matches: list[dict],
    88→    *,

    92→    top: int,

    95→    noise_budget: int,
    96→    global_noise_budget: int,
    97→    budget_warning: str | None,
    98→) -> None:
    99→    """Render grouped findings and rollup summary to terminal."""
   100→    sorted_files = group_matches_by_file(matches)
   101→    print(
   102→        colorize(

   112→        )
   113→        hidden_parts = ", ".join(

   125→        )

   129→    remaining_findings = sum(len(files) for _, files in remaining_files)
   130→

   208→def show_agent_plan(
   209→    narrative: dict, matches: list[dict], *, plan: dict | None = None
   210→) -> None:
   211→    """Render a compact plan from current findings and narrative actions.

1→"""Scorecard dimension row helpers for the engine/planning layer.
     2→
     3→Provides ``scorecard_dimension_rows`` without importing app-layer modules.
     4→The app scorecard surface re-exports this so external call-sites are unaffected.
     5→"""
     6→
     7→from __future__ import annotations
     8→
     9→from desloppify.scoring import DIMENSIONS
    10→
    11→
    12→def scorecard_dimension_rows(
    13→    state: dict,
    14→    *,
    15→    dim_scores: dict | None = None,
    16→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    17→    """Return scorecard rows using canonical dimension ordering.
    18→
    19→    Tries ``prepare_scorecard_dimensions`` from the app layer when available
    20→    (deferred import to avoid hard engine -> app dependency), then falls back
    21→    to a simple mechanical-dimension listing.
    22→    """
    23→    if dim_scores is None:
    24→        dim_scores = (
    25→            state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if isinstance(state, dict) else {}
    26→        )
    27→        projected_state = state
    28→    else:
    29→        projected_state = dict(state)
    30→        projected_state["dimension_scores"] = dim_scores
    31→
    32→    # Try the full app-layer scorecard projection when it can be imported.
    33→    try:
    34→        from desloppify.app.output.scorecard_parts.dimensions import (
    35→            prepare_scorecard_dimensions,
    36→        )
    37→
    38→        rows = prepare_scorecard_dimensions(projected_state)
    39→        if rows:
    40→            return rows
    41→    except ImportError as exc:
    42→        _ = exc
    43→
    44→    # Fallback for synthetic/unit-test states without full scorecard context.
    45→    fallback_dim_scores = dim_scores or {}
    46→    if not isinstance(fallback_dim_scores, dict):
    47→        return []
    48→
    49→    mechanical_names = [dimension.name for dimension in DIMENSIONS]
    50→    fallback_rows: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    51→    for name in mechanical_names:
    52→        data = fallback_dim_scores.get(name)
    53→        if isinstance(data, dict):
    54→            fallback_rows.append((name, data))
    55→    fallback_rows.extend(
    56→        sorted(
    57→            [
    58→                (name, data)
    59→                for name, data in fallback_dim_scores.items()
    60→                if name not in mechanical_names and isinstance(data, dict)
    61→            ],
    62→            key=lambda item: item[0].lower(),
    63→        )
    64→    )
    65→    return fallback_rows
    66→
```

    16→def _lang_from_scan_history(state: dict) -> str | None:
    17→    history = state.get("scan_history")
    18→    if not isinstance(history, list):
    19→        return None
    20→    for entry in reversed(history):
    21→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
    22→            continue
    23→        lang = entry.get("lang")
    24→        if isinstance(lang, str) and lang.strip():
    25→            return lang.strip().lower()
    26→    return None
    27→
    28→
    29→def _lang_from_capabilities(state: dict) -> str | None:
    30→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities")
    31→    if not isinstance(capabilities, dict) or len(capabilities) != 1:
    32→        return None
    33→    only_lang = next(iter(capabilities.keys()))
    34→    if isinstance(only_lang, str) and only_lang.strip():
    35→        return only_lang.strip().lower()
    36→    return None
    37→
    38→
    39→def _lang_from_findings(state: dict) -> str | None:
    40→    findings = state.get("findings")
    41→    if not isinstance(findings, dict):
    42→        return None
    43→    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    44→    for finding in findings.values():
    45→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
    46→            continue
    47→        lang = finding.get("lang")
    48→        if not isinstance(lang, str) or not lang.strip():
    49→            continue
    50→        key = lang.strip().lower()
    51→        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    52→    if counts:
    53→        return max(counts, key=counts.get)
    54→    return None
    55→
    56→
    57→def resolve_scorecard_lang(state: dict) -> str | None:
    58→    """Best-effort current scan language key for scorecard display policy."""
    59→    return (
    60→        _lang_from_scan_history(state)
    61→        or _lang_from_capabilities(state)
    62→        or _lang_from_findings(state)
    63→    )

    69→        and data.get("score", 0) == 0
    70→        and data.get("issues", 0) == 0
    71→    )

    74→def collapse_elegance_dimensions(
    75→    active_dims: list[tuple[str, dict]],
    76→    *,
    77→    lang_key: str | None,
    78→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    79→    """Collapse High/Mid/Low elegance rows into one aggregate display row."""
    80→    component_names = set(
    81→        _ELEGANCE_COMPONENTS_BY_LANG.get(lang_key or "", _DEFAULT_ELEGANCE_COMPONENTS)
    82→    )
    83→    elegance_rows = [
    84→        (name, data) for name, data in active_dims if name in component_names
    85→    ]
    86→    if not elegance_rows:
    87→        return active_dims
    88→
    89→    remaining_rows = [
    90→        (name, data) for name, data in active_dims if name not in component_names
    91→    ]
    92→    count = len(elegance_rows)
    93→    score_avg = round(
    94→        sum(float(data.get("score", 100.0)) for _, data in elegance_rows) / count, 1
    95→    )
    96→    strict_avg = round(
    97→        sum(
    98→            float(data.get("strict", data.get("score", 100.0)))
    99→            for _, data in elegance_rows
   100→        )
   101→        / count,
   102→        1,
   103→    )
   104→    checks_total = sum(int(data.get("checks", 0)) for _, data in elegance_rows)
   105→    issues_total = sum(int(data.get("issues", 0)) for _, data in elegance_rows)
   106→    tier = max(int(data.get("tier", 4)) for _, data in elegance_rows)
   107→    placeholder_flags = [
   108→        bool(
   109→            data.get("detectors", {})
   110→            .get("subjective_assessment", {})
   111→            .get("placeholder")
   112→        )
   113→        for _, data in elegance_rows
   114→    ]
   115→
   116→    label = "Elegance"
   117→    if any(name.lower() == label.lower() for name, _ in remaining_rows):
   118→        label = "Elegance (combined)"
   119→
   120→    pass_rate = round(score_avg / 100.0, 4)
   121→    combined_entry = {
   122→        "score": score_avg,
   123→        "strict": strict_avg,
   124→        "checks": checks_total,
   125→        "issues": issues_total,
   126→        "tier": tier,
   127→        "detectors": {
   128→            "subjective_assessment": {
   129→                "potential": checks_total,
   130→                "pass_rate": pass_rate,
   131→                "issues": issues_total,
   132→                "weighted_failures": round(checks_total * (1 - pass_rate), 4),
   133→                "components": [name for name, _ in elegance_rows],
   134→            }
   135→        },
   136→    }
   137→    combined_entry["detectors"]["subjective_assessment"]["placeholder"] = any(
   138→        placeholder_flags
   139→    )
   140→    return [*remaining_rows, (label, combined_entry)]
   141→
   142→
   143→def limit_scorecard_dimensions(
   144→    active_dims: list[tuple[str, dict]],
   145→    *,
   146→    lang_key: str | None,
   147→    max_rows: int = SCORECARD_MAX_DIMENSIONS,
   148→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
   149→    """Limit scorecard rows with language-specific subjective priority."""
   150→    if len(active_dims) <= max_rows:
   151→        return active_dims
   152→
   153→    mechanical = [
   154→        (name, data)
   155→        for name, data in active_dims
   156→        if "subjective_assessment" not in data.get("detectors", {})
   157→    ]
   158→    subjective = [
   159→        (name, data)
   160→        for name, data in active_dims
   161→        if "subjective_assessment" in data.get("detectors", {})
   162→    ]
   163→    if len(mechanical) >= max_rows:
   164→        return mechanical[:max_rows]
   165→
   166→    budget = max_rows - len(mechanical)
   167→    preferred_order = _SUBJECTIVE_SCORECARD_ORDER_BY_LANG.get(
   168→        lang_key or "",
   169→        _SUBJECTIVE_SCORECARD_ORDER_DEFAULT,
   170→    )
   171→
   172→    remaining = {name: (name, data) for name, data in subjective}
   173→    selected: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
   174→    for name in preferred_order:
   175→        row = remaining.pop(name, None)
   176→        if row is None:
   177→            continue
   178→        selected.append(row)
   179→        if len(selected) >= budget:
   180→            break
   181→
   182→    if len(selected) < budget and remaining:
   183→        extras = sorted(
   184→            remaining.values(),
   185→            key=lambda item: (
   186→                float(item[1].get("strict", item[1].get("score", 100.0))),
   187→                item[0],
   188→            ),
   189→        )
   190→        selected.extend(extras[: budget - len(selected)])
   191→
   192→    return [*mechanical, *selected]
   193→
   194→
   195→def prepare_scorecard_dimensions(state: dict) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
   196→    """Prepare scorecard rows (active, elegance-collapsed, capped).
   197→
   198→    Dimensions are derived dynamically from what the scoring engine produced
   199→    in ``dimension_scores`` — no per-language hard-coded dimension list.
   200→    Unassessed subjective placeholders (score 0, no issues) are excluded so
   201→    the scorecard only shows dimensions that have real data.
   202→    """
   203→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   204→    if not isinstance(dim_scores, dict):
   205→        return []
   206→
   207→    all_dims = [
   208→        (name, data) for name, data in dim_scores.items() if isinstance(data, dict)
   209→    ]
   210→
   211→    [REDACTED](state)
   212→    all_dims = collapse_elegance_dimensions(all_dims, lang_key=lang_key)
   213→
   214→    # Show dimensions with real data; skip unassessed subjective placeholders.
   215→    active_dims = [
   216→        (name, data)
   217→        for name, data in all_dims
   218→        if data.get("checks", 0) > 0 and not is_unassessed_subjective_placeholder(data)
   219→    ]
   220→    active_dims = limit_scorecard_dimensions(active_dims, lang_key=lang_key)
   221→    active_dims.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if x[0] == "File health" else 1, x[0]))
   222→    return active_dims
   223→
   224→

   227→    "collapse_elegance_dimensions",
   228→    "prepare_scorecard_dimensions",
   229→    "limit_scorecard_dimensions",
   230→    "resolve_scorecard_lang",
   231→]

1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions``, ``auto_cluster``, and ``_work_queue/core``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    13→
    14→# Detectors whose findings are NOT objective mechanical work.
    15→# Canonical definition — re-exported by stale_dimensions for back-compat.
    16→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    17→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    18→})
    19→
    20→
    21→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    22→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    23→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    24→
    25→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective findings?
    26→    objective_count: int  # how many
    27→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    28→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    29→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    30→
    31→    def should_surface(self, item: dict) -> bool:
    32→        """Should this subjective queue item appear in the work queue?
    33→
    34→        Unscored (initial_review) -> always.  All others -> only when drained.
    35→        """
    36→        if item.get("initial_review"):
    37→            return True
    38→        return not self.has_objective_backlog
    39→
    40→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    41→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    42→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    43→            return True  # unconditional
    44→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    45→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    46→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    47→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    48→        return False
    49→
    50→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    51→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    52→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    53→            return False  # never evict unscored
    54→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    55→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    56→        return False
    57→
    58→    @property
    59→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    60→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    61→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    62→
    63→
    64→def _is_evidence_only(finding: dict) -> bool:
    65→    """Return True if the finding is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    66→    from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
    67→    from desloppify.engine.planning.common import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    68→
    69→    detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    70→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    71→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    72→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    73→        finding_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(finding.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    74→        if finding_rank > threshold_rank:
    75→            return True
    76→    return False
    77→
    78→
    79→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    80→    state: StateModel,
    81→    *,
    82→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
    83→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    84→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    85→
    86→    Imports building-block helpers from ``stale_dimensions`` so the
    87→    source-of-truth logic stays in one place.
    88→    """
    89→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
    90→        _current_stale_ids,
    91→        current_under_target_ids,
    92→        current_unscored_ids,
    93→    )
    94→
    95→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
    96→
    97→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective findings.
    98→    # Evidence-only findings (below standalone confidence threshold) are
    99→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   100→    objective_count = sum(
   101→        1
   102→        for f in findings.values()
   103→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   104→        and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   105→        and not f.get("suppressed")
   106→        and not _is_evidence_only(f)
   107→    )
   108→
   109→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   110→    stale = _current_stale_ids(state)
   111→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   112→
   113→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   114→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   115→        objective_count=objective_count,
   116→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   117→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),

   150→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (

   152→    )

   154→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}

   166→        if strict_val >= target_strict:

   177→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   178→# Promoted-aware insertion helper
   179→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   180→
   181→def _after_promoted(order: list[str], plan: PlanModel) -> int:
   182→    """Return the insertion index just after the last promoted item in *order*.
   183→
   184→    When no promoted items are present (or none are in *order*), returns 0
   185→    so callers fall back to existing front-of-queue behavior.
   186→    """
   187→    promoted = set(plan.get("promoted_ids", []))
   188→    if not promoted:
   189→        return 0
   190→    last_idx = -1
   191→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   192→        if fid in promoted:
   193→            last_idx = i
   194→    return last_idx + 1 if last_idx >= 0 else 0

   197→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   198→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   199→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   200→
   201→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   202→    plan: PlanModel,
   203→    state: StateModel,
   204→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   205→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   206→
   207→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   208→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   209→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   210→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   211→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   212→    """
   213→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   214→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   215→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   216→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   217→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   218→
   219→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   220→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   221→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   222→        fid for fid in order
   223→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   224→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   225→        and fid not in stale_ids
   226→    ]
   227→    for fid in to_remove:
   228→        order.remove(fid)
   229→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   230→
   231→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   232→    existing = set(order)
   233→    insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   234→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   235→        if uid not in existing:
   236→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   237→            result.injected.append(uid)
   238→
   239→    return result
   240→

   242→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   243→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   244→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   245→
   246→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   247→    plan: PlanModel,
   248→    state: StateModel,
   249→    *,
   250→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   251→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   252→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   253→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   254→
   255→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   256→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   257→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   258→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   259→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   260→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   261→          review takes priority over new objective findings).
   262→    """
   263→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   264→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   265→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   266→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   267→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   268→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   269→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   270→
   271→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   272→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   273→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   274→        fid for fid in order
   275→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   276→        and fid not in injectable_ids
   277→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   278→    ]
   279→    for fid in to_remove:
   280→        order.remove(fid)
   281→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   282→
   283→    # --- Inject: populate stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   284→    if policy is not None:
   285→        has_real_items = policy.has_objective_backlog
   286→    else:
   287→        has_real_items = any(
   288→            f.get("status") == "open"
   289→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   290→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   291→            for f in state.get("findings", {}).values()
   292→        )
   293→
   294→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   295→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   296→        existing = set(order)
   297→        if cycle_just_completed and has_real_items:
   298→            # Post-cycle: front-of-queue after promoted items so subjective
   299→            # review happens before the new objective cycle begins.
   300→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   301→            for sid in reversed(sorted(injectable_ids)):
   302→                if sid not in existing:
   303→                    order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   304→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   305→        else:
   306→            # Mid-cycle or no objective backlog: append to back.
   307→            for sid in sorted(injectable_ids):
   308→                if sid not in existing:
   309→                    order.append(sid)
   310→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   311→
   312→    return result
   313→
   314→
   315→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   316→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   317→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   318→
   319→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   320→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   321→
   322→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   323→    """
   324→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   325→    review_ids = sorted(
   326→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   327→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   328→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   329→    )
   330→    if not review_ids:
   331→        return ""
   332→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   333→
   334→
   335→@dataclass
   336→class TriageSyncResult:
   337→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   338→
   339→    injected: bool = False
   340→    pruned: bool = False
   341→
   342→    @property
   343→    def changes(self) -> int:
   344→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   345→
   346→
   347→def sync_triage_needed(
   348→    plan: PlanModel,
   349→    state: StateModel,
   350→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   351→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review findings change.
   352→
   353→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   354→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion removes them.
   355→
   356→    When findings are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   357→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   358→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   359→    """
   360→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   361→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   362→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   363→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   364→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   365→
   366→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   367→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   368→
   369→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   370→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   371→
   372→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   373→        # Distinguish "new findings appeared" from "findings were resolved".
   374→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new findings exist.
   375→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   376→        current_review_ids = {
   377→            fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   378→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   379→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   380→        }
   381→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   382→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   383→
   384→        if new_since_triage:
   385→            # New review findings appeared — re-triage needed
   386→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   387→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   388→            existing = set(order)
   389→            injected_count = 0
   390→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   391→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   392→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   393→                    injected_count += 1
   394→            if injected_count:
   395→                result.injected = True
   396→        else:
   397→            # Only resolved findings changed the hash — update silently
   398→            meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   399→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   400→
   401→    return result
   402→

   404→@dataclass
   405→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   406→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   407→
   408→    injected: bool = False
   409→
   410→    @property
   411→    def changes(self) -> int:
   412→        return int(self.injected)

   414→
   415→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   416→    plan: PlanModel,
   417→    state: StateModel,
   418→    *,
   419→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   420→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   421→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   422→
   423→    Only injects when:
   424→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   425→    - At least one objective finding exists
   426→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   427→    - No triage stages are pending
   428→    """
   429→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   430→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   431→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   432→
   433→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   434→        return result
   435→
   436→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   437→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   438→        return result
   439→
   440→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   441→    if policy is not None:
   442→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   443→            return result
   444→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   445→    else:
   446→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   447→        if unscored:
   448→            return result
   449→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   450→        has_objective = any(
   451→            f.get("status") == "open"
   452→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   453→            for f in findings.values()
   454→        )
   455→    if not has_objective:
   456→        return result
   457→
   458→    # Insert after any subjective items, before findings
   459→    insert_at = 0
   460→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   461→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX):
   462→            insert_at = i + 1
   463→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   464→    result.injected = True
   465→    return result
   466→
   467→
   468→def compute_new_finding_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   469→    """Return the set of open review/concerns finding IDs added since last triage.
   470→
   471→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   472→    """
   473→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   474→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   475→    current = {
   476→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   477→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   478→    }
   479→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   480→
   481→
   482→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   483→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   484→
   485→    Returns True when any ``triage::*`` stage ID is in the queue OR
   486→    genuinely *new* review findings appeared since the last triage.
   487→
   488→    When findings are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   489→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   490→    through the plan.
   491→    """
   492→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   493→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   494→    if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
   495→        return True
   496→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   497→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   498→    if not last_hash:
   499→        return False
   500→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   501→    if not current_hash or current_hash == last_hash:
   502→        return False
   503→    # Hash changed — check if new findings appeared or only resolutions
   504→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   505→    current_review_ids = {
   506→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   507→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   508→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   509→    }
   510→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   511→    new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   512→    return bool(new_since_triage)
   513→

1→"""Scope and queue helpers for show command selection."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→
     7→from desloppify import scoring as scoring_mod
     8→from desloppify import state as state_mod
     9→from desloppify.core import registry as registry_mod
    10→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import (
    11→    QueueBuildOptions,
    12→    build_work_queue,
    13→)
    14→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
    15→
    16→
    17→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    18→class ResolvedEntity:
    19→    """Classifies what the user's show pattern refers to."""
    20→
    21→    kind: str  # "dimension", "special_view", "file_or_pattern"
    22→    pattern: str  # Original user pattern
    23→    display_name: str  # Human-readable label
    24→    detectors: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # Detector names (for dimension kind)
    25→    is_subjective: bool = False  # Whether this is a subjective dimension
    26→
    27→
    28→def _resolve_special_view(pattern: str, lowered: str) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    29→    if lowered not in ("concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"):
    30→        return None
    31→    return ResolvedEntity(
    32→        kind="special_view",
    33→        pattern=pattern,
    34→        display_name=pattern,
    35→    )
    36→
    37→
    38→def _resolve_mechanical_dimension(pattern: str, lowered: str) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    39→    lookup = _build_dimension_lookup()
    40→    detectors = lookup.get(lowered) or lookup.get(pattern.lower())
    41→    if not detectors:
    42→        return None
    43→    dim_display = pattern
    44→    for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
    45→        dim_lowered = dim.name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
    46→        if dim.name.lower() == lowered or dim_lowered == lowered:
    47→            dim_display = dim.name
    48→            break
    49→    return ResolvedEntity(
    50→        kind="dimension",
    51→        pattern=pattern,
    52→        display_name=dim_display,
    53→        detectors=tuple(detectors),
    54→        is_subjective=False,
    55→    )
    56→
    57→
    58→def _resolve_subjective_dimension(
    59→    pattern: str,
    60→    lowered: str,
    61→    state: dict,
    62→) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    63→    display_name = scoring_mod.DISPLAY_NAMES.get(lowered)
    64→    if not display_name:
    65→        for key in state.get("dimension_scores") or {}:
    66→            if key.lower().replace(" ", "_") == lowered:
    67→                display_name = key
    68→                break
    69→    if not display_name:
    70→        return None
    71→    dim_data, display_name = _lookup_dimension_score(state, display_name)
    72→    is_subj = "subjective_assessment" in (
    73→        dim_data.get("detectors", {}) if isinstance(dim_data, dict) else {}
    74→    )
    75→    return ResolvedEntity(
    76→        kind="dimension",
    77→        pattern=pattern,
    78→        display_name=display_name,
    79→        detectors=(),
    80→        is_subjective=is_subj,
    81→    )
    82→
    83→
    84→def resolve_entity(pattern: str, state: dict) -> ResolvedEntity:
    85→    """Classify a user pattern as a dimension, special view, or passthrough.
    86→
    87→    Resolution priority:
    88→    1. Special views: "concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"
    89→    2. Mechanical dimension name (from DIMENSIONS)
    90→    3. Subjective dimension name (from DISPLAY_NAMES / dimension_scores)
    91→    4. Everything else: file_or_pattern passthrough
    92→    """
    93→    lowered = pattern.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
    94→
    95→    # 1. Special views
    96→    special_view = _resolve_special_view(pattern, lowered)
    97→    if special_view is not None:
    98→        return special_view
    99→
   100→    # 2. Mechanical dimension (via DIMENSIONS list)
   101→    mechanical = _resolve_mechanical_dimension(pattern, lowered)
   102→    if mechanical is not None:
   103→        return mechanical
   104→
   105→    # 3. Subjective dimension (via DISPLAY_NAMES or dimension_scores)
   106→    subjective = _resolve_subjective_dimension(pattern, lowered, state)
   107→    if subjective is not None:
   108→        return subjective
   109→
   110→    # 4. Everything else
   111→    return ResolvedEntity(
   112→        kind="file_or_pattern",
   113→        pattern=pattern,
   114→        display_name=pattern,
   115→    )
   116→
   117→
   118→def _build_dimension_lookup() -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   119→    """Build a map from dimension name/key (lowered) to detector names."""
   120→    lookup: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   121→    for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
   122→        detectors = list(dim.detectors) if hasattr(dim, "detectors") else []
   123→        lookup[dim.name.lower()] = detectors
   124→        # Also index by underscore key: "file_health" -> detectors
   125→        key = dim.name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   126→        if key not in lookup:
   127→            lookup[key] = detectors
   128→    # Also add DISPLAY_NAMES reverse lookup (e.g. "abstraction_fit" -> "Abstraction Fit")
   129→    for key, display in scoring_mod.DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   130→        normalized_key = key.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   131→        normalized_display = display.lower()
   132→        # Find which dimension this belongs to via get_dimension_for_detector or direct name match
   133→        for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
   134→            dim_lower = dim.name.lower()
   135→            if normalized_display == dim_lower or normalized_key == dim_lower.replace(" ", "_"):
   136→                detectors = list(dim.detectors) if hasattr(dim, "detectors") else []
   137→                if normalized_key not in lookup:
   138→                    lookup[normalized_key] = detectors
   139→                if normalized_display not in lookup:
   140→                    lookup[normalized_display] = detectors
   141→    return lookup
   142→
   143→
   144→def _lookup_dimension_score(
   145→    state: dict, display_name: str,
   146→) -> tuple[dict, str]:
   147→    """Find dimension_scores entry with case-insensitive fallback.
   148→
   149→    Returns (dim_data_dict, resolved_display_name).
   150→    """
   151→    lowered = display_name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   152→    dim_data = (state.get("dimension_scores") or {}).get(display_name, {})
   153→    if not dim_data:
   154→        for ds_key, ds_val in (state.get("dimension_scores") or {}).items():
   155→            if ds_key.lower().replace(" ", "_") == lowered:
   156→                dim_data = ds_val
   157→                display_name = ds_key
   158→                break
   159→    return dim_data, display_name
   160→
   161→
   162→def _detector_names_hint() -> str:
   163→    """Return a compact list of detector names for the help message."""
   164→    names = getattr(registry_mod, "DISPLAY_ORDER", [])
   165→    if names:
   166→        return ", ".join(names[:10]) + (", ..." if len(names) > 10 else "")
   167→    return "smells, structural, security, review, ..."
   168→
   169→
   170→def resolve_show_scope(args) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str, str | None]:
   171→    """Resolve scope/pattern/status for a show invocation."""
   172→    chronic = getattr(args, "chronic", False)
   173→    pattern = args.pattern
   174→    status_filter = "open" if chronic else getattr(args, "status", "open")
   175→    if chronic:
   176→        scope = pattern
   177→        pattern = pattern or "<chronic>"
   178→        return True, pattern, status_filter, scope
   179→    if not pattern:
   180→        print(
   181→            colorize(
   182→                "Pattern required (or use --chronic). Try: desloppify show --help",
   183→                "yellow",
   184→            )
   185→        )
   186→        return False, None, status_filter, ""
   187→    return True, pattern, status_filter, pattern
   188→
   189→
   190→def load_matches(
   191→    state: dict,
   192→    *,
   193→    scope: str | None,
   194→    status_filter: str,
   195→    chronic: bool,
   196→) -> list[dict]:
   197→    """Load matching findings from the ranked queue."""
   198→    queue = build_work_queue(
   199→        state,
   200→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   201→            count=None,
   202→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   203→            scope=scope,
   204→            status=status_filter,
   205→            include_subjective=False,
   206→            chronic=chronic,
   207→        ),
   208→    )
   209→    return [item for item in queue.get("items", []) if item.get("kind") == "finding"]
   210→
   211→
   212→def resolve_noise(config: dict, matches: list[dict], *, no_budget: bool = False):
   213→    """Apply detector/global noise budget to show matches.
   214→
   215→    When *no_budget* is True, all matches are surfaced (nothing hidden).
   216→    """
   217→    if no_budget:
   218→        return (
   219→            matches,
   220→            {},
   221→            0,
   222→            0,
   223→            None,
   224→        )
   225→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   226→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   227→    )
   228→    surfaced_matches, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   229→        matches,
   230→        budget=noise_budget,
   231→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   232→    )
   233→    return (
   234→        surfaced_matches,
   235→        hidden_by_detector,
   236→        noise_budget,
   237→        global_noise_budget,
   238→        budget_warning,
   239→    )
   240→
   241→
   242→__all__ = [
   243→    "ResolvedEntity",
   244→    "_detector_names_hint",
   245→    "_lookup_dimension_score",
   246→    "load_matches",
   247→    "resolve_entity",
   248→    "resolve_noise",
   249→    "resolve_show_scope",
   250→]
   251→
```
